purpose: Compact provider model metadata for the real-LLM pilot. This preserves model identity without requiring raw request/response transcripts to be tracked in Git.
notes: Raw call transcripts are local/external-archive artifacts because they contain provider request/response payloads and are not byte-reproducible by rerunning providers.
